_authoring.status: Staged; not part of the production scenario loader.
_authoring.scope: Ashina 12 + Mogami 10 + Nanbu 10 + Ando 8 = 40 distinct named people.

sourceClasses.andoCorrection: prefectural edited history; editorial corrections to a later chronicle

_authoring.sourceBoundaries: Institutional catalogues establish identities or dated activity, not every lifespan or continuous 1560 service. Unknown numerical dates are authored estimates. Secondary-only evidence is labelled.
_authoring.placementBoundaries: Capital stations aggregate regional households for scenario play. Independent Kunohe and Nikaido houses are not represented as historically proven direct retainers. Later Mogami service is deferred.
_authoring.kinBoundary: Kin flags require an attested son, uncle, cousin or sibling relationship to the actual leader. Shared surnames, household membership and marriage are insufficient.
pdfChecks: Aizumisato chronology, single-page table: visually inspected 1574 and 1580 rows.
Tokyo catalogue, printed 163 / PDF page 23: visually inspected document 1-03-019.
Akita exhibition, printed 5 / PDF page 6: visually inspected full names and document dates.
Fukushima education newsletter 127, printed 5 / PDF page 3: visually inspected the municipal education board's Sase father-and-son memorial account.
knownBoundaries: Otaka Yasuzumi full-name evidence is secondary; Chikuzen-no-kami is not an established alias.
Minato Shigesue's 1589 catalogue attribution requires caution; the lifespan is explicitly authored.
Morioki death differs between municipal chronology 1574 and lecture 1575.
Mogami Yoshiaki genpuku traditions differ; engine availability still requires age 15.
Unknown initial-service dates for document-attested Ando staff are scenario design, not proven 1560 office dates.
aliasesNotSeparate: Honjo Mitsushige / Tateoka Mitsushige / Yuzawa Mitsushige / Akaotsu Mitsushige.
Ando Chikasue / Shimokuni Chikasue / Akita Chikasue.
Earlier Inawashiro Morikuni is not the late-sixteenth-century officer.

excludedIdentities.reason: Birth 1570 and death 1582 in the municipal chronology precede the minimum adult debut. Not used as an available heir.
Birth 1576 exceeds the officer schema's 1570 maximum. Not shifted earlier to fill this quota.
